tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i rnam par thar pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// kun nas mdzes pa'i sku mnga' 'gro rnams dga' mdzad gsung*// rgyal ba'i thugs dang rab ldan shes bya'i mtshan nyid mkhyen// dpal ldan yon tan phun tshogs phrin las bzang po can// brtse bas phal pa'i tshul 'dzin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// bde gshegs kun gyi mdzad pa rab bsgrub phyir// khyod kyi rnam thar brjod pa su yis spobs// 'on kyang thun mong 'gro la gsal gyur ba'i// mkhas pa'i tshul lugs cung zad brjod pa mtshar// bdag gi bla ma chos kyi rje chen po lus can rnams kyi rtsa lag dam pa/ yon tan rin po che du mas brgyan cing*/ mkhas pa'i skye bo rnams kyis bsngags pa'i gnas su gyur pa'i/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta zhes kun la grags pa 'di ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen thos pa dang bsam pa dang bsgrub pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa/ 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrungs pa dang*/ de nyid kyi gcung po rdo rje rin po che nas gdung rabs bcu gcig tu brgyud pa 'di ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dkon mchog rgyal po yin la/ de thams cad kyang yon tan dang ldan pa grub pa sna re brnyes pa sha stag yin gsung ngo*// de'i sras bla ma rin po che sa skya pa zhes grags pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi byin gyis brlabs shing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che dang ldan pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa chen po yin no// de'i sras gsum gyi gcen po slob dpon rin po che mdo rgyud thams cad kyi mnga' bdag blo gsal zhing brtson pa dang ldan pa/ rtsom pa la mkhas par gyur pa yin no// bar pa rje btsun rin po che yon tan tshad med pa mnga' ba/ mkhas pa'i skyes bu mchog tu gyur pa yin la/ de gnyi ga yang tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa'o// gcung po dpal chen 'od po zhes bya ba'i sras gnyis kyi gcen 'di yin te/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen rig pa mchog tu gyur pa/ kun gyis bkur ba'i gnas/ 'od zer brgya pa'i snang bas gsal bar byed pa ltar 'gran zla dang bral ba yin no// bdag nyid chen po 'di sku tshe snga ma rnams su bsod nams kyi bya ba phul du phyin par bsags shing*/ skyes bu mkhas pa rnams bsten te shes bya'i gnas la sbyangs nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la brtson pa cher mdzad pa'i stobs kyis/ skabs 'dir yang rigs dang gzugs bzang zhing*/ 'byor pa dang ldan pa la kun gyis bkur ba dang bsngags pa byed pa/ yid du 'ong ba/ dbang po'i sgo thams cad gsal zhing rdzogs la/ blo gros rgya che ba/ snying rje che bas gzhan don la brtson zhing*/ shes bya phal che ba rang byung du mkhyen la/ bsgrub pa la gtsor mdzad cing*/ gzhon nu nyid nas chos dang ldan pa nyid du gyur to// mkha' la bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor can// rgyu skar dbus na 'dzum zhing mdzes// de bzhin skyes chen dam pa khyed// dpal 'byor dkyil na rnam par 'dzum// nyin mor byed pa shar ba na// 'od zer tshogs kyis kun tu gsal// mi dbang rgyal po bltams pa na// blo gros 'od zer phyogs bcur khyab// dpag bsam ljon pa skyes pa'i dus// 'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub par byed// de bzhin kun dga' gzhon nu nas// gzhan la phan pa kho na sgrub// a dum wā ra kha bye ba// dbyibs mdzes mdog bzang lhun gyis grub// chos kyi dbang phyug 'khrungs pa na// yon tan lhun grub gyur pa lags// rang rgyal rnams kyi ye shes kyang*// bag chags sad pa'i stobs kyis rtogs// khyod kyang sngar sbyangs bag chags kyis// shes bya phal cher mkhyen par gyur// de ltar bdag nyid chen po 'di bu chung gog nas gshegs pa'i dus na yang sa la phyag gis ā li kā li rnams rdzogs par 'dri zhing*/ de la mi 'goms par yang na bskor nas gshegs/ yang na bsubs nas 'jog pas nye 'khor na gnas pa'i gang zag thams cad kyang 'di ni 'phags pa'i sprul pa'am/

sngon sbyangs pa'i bag chags sad pa cig yin nges zhes zer zhing ngo mtshar du gyur to// de ltar sku tshe snga ma la goms pa'i bag chags sad pa'i stobs dang*/ rang bzhin gyi che ba dang ldan pas rig pa'i gnas rnams phal che ba/ 'bad pa ma mdzad pa la mkhas par gyur te/ de'i rim pa cung zad brjod na/ rig pa'i gnas lnga las/ phyi rig pa ni rgya gar dang bod kyi yi ge'i bye brag rnams 'dri ba dang*/ klog pa dang*/ ri mo dang*/ rkos dang*/ 'bur dang*/ lugs ma dang*/ lde gu la sogs pa'i gzugs dang*/ bye brag rnams kyi bsgrub tshul dang*/ mtshan nyid dang*/ chag tshad dang*// tshon mdangs dang*/ sdeb tshul dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ rin po che'i sbyor tshul la sogs pa dang*/ gzugs brnyan dang*/ pa tra dang*/ rnam 'gyur sna tshogs dang*/ lag gi bzo'i bye brag thams cad la yang*/ rje btsun chen pos phyogs tsam bstan pa tsam mam/ gzhan gyis byed pa gzigs pa'am/ gzhan dag byed pa gsan pa'am/ rang gis 'gran pa tsam la brten nas/ shin tu mkhas shing byang bar gyur ro// 'bad pa chen pos yun ring du bslabs pa'i mkhas pa rnams pas kyang mchog tu gyur to// rin po che dang*/ skyes pa dang*/ bud med dang*/ rta dang*/ glang po che dang*/ sman dang*/ gos la sogs pa'i brtag pa'i bye brag rnams dang*/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba dang*/ lugs kyi bstan bcos la rab tu mkhas par gyur te/ tsa na ka dang*/ ba su rak+ṣa dang*/ lugs chen po'i gtam rgyud lnga pa la sogs pa dang*/ skye bo gso ba la sogs pa mang du rje btsun rin po che las gsan cing byang bar mdzad do// dus phyis legs par bshad pa'i gter zhes 'jig rten gyi bya ba dang chos lugs bsgrub pa'ang mdzad do// spos sbyor dang rol mo sil snyan dang*/ zlos gar rnams la mkhas shing de dag gi bstan bcos kyang mang du gsan cing bstan bcos kyang mdzad do// 'byung ba dang*/ sa dpyad dang*/ lo zla dang*/ dus tshod dang*/ gza' skar dang*/

nyi zla dang*/ 'pho ba dang*/ dus sbyor dang*/ rten 'brel dang*/ sgra skad dang*/ phyi nang gi rtsis rnams la rgya rtsis kyi bye brag rnams dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang*/ ā li kā li dang*/ sgra dang*/ ltas brtags pa'i bye brag gzhan rnams dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje nas bshad pa'i phyi dang nang gi rtsis rnams dang bcas pa thams cad chos rje nyid las gsan cing mkhas pa phul du phyin pa'o// phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' rig byed pa dang*/ ser skya ba dang*/ gzegs zan dang*/ rgyal ba dam pa dang*/ phur bu la sogs pa'i lta ba'i bye brag rnams legs par rtogs pa yin no// gnyis pa gso ba rig pa ni/ nad kyi rgyu dang nad kyi gzhi gang las gyur pa dang*/ rgyur tshul gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ brtag pa dang*/ gso ba dang*/ nad mi 'byung bar bya ba dang*/ sman gyi sbyor tshul dang*/ bsten thabs dang*/ dpyad kyi rim pa dang*/ khams gso ba'i tshul rnams la shin tu mkhas shing*/ sman gyi gzhung la yang yan lag brgyad pa'i rtsa 'grel/ gso ma ra tsa/ rig pa rtsa mdo/ a tsa ra'i skor/ rgyud phra mo gzhan/ gdams pa sum cu pa/ nyi ma'i 'od zer la sogs pa spyi dang bye brag gi man ngag du ma rnams rjes sku mched las bslabs shing*/ sman dang sngags kyi gso ba shes pa gzhan gyis kyang phul bas nad sel ba'i gnad thams cad mnga' zhing*/ gso ba rig pa la mkhas pa'i mchog dang pa'o// gsum pa sgra rig pa ni/ rgya gar la legs par sbyar ba dang*/ rang bzhin dang*/ zur chag pa dang*/ sha za'i skad dang*/ bod kyi brda rnams legs par shes shing*/ sgra bsgrub pa'i tshul la yang*/ sgra 'byung ba'i gnas dang*/ mdo dang*/ khams dang*/ rnam par dbye ba dang*/ byed tshig dang*/ rtag dang*/ nye bar sgyur ba dang*/ dbye bsdu dang*/ tshig gi rgyan dang*/ sdeb tshul dang*/ dpe don dang*/ yi ge'i lce yang dang*/

sbyor ba dang*/ ming gi rnam grangs dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa'i dbye ba dang*/ tshig lhug pa'i sdeb tshul la sogs pa/ brda sbyor ba dang*/ snyan ngag dang*/ sdeb sbyor rnams la rgya gar kyi paṇ+ḍi ta yongs su rdzogs pa dang mtshungs shing mkhas pa'i skyes bu yin nges so// bzhi pa gtan tshigs rig pa ni shes bya mngon gyur dang lkog gyur la mngon sum dang rjes dpag gis gtan la phab nas/ tshad ma dang*/ tshad ma ma yin pa'i blo rnam par phye ste/ bsgrub pa dang sun 'byin pa'i ngag la skyon med pas/ gzhan gyi gzhung phyin ci log rnams sun 'byin cing*/ rang gi grub pa'i mtha' yang dag pa nyid du bsgrubs nas rgol ba ngan pa'i log rtog bsal te/ bden pa'i grub mtha' la btsud nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa la/ chos grags blo'i dbang po dang tshul mtshungs pa/ rtog ge pa rnams kyi nang nas gtsug gi nor bu lta bu'o// lnga pa nang rig pa ni/ thub pa'i gsung rab mdo sde dang*/ rgyud sde dang*/ de gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos dang*/ zab pa'i gnas ston pa'i man ngag dang bcas pa mkhyen cing*/ rigs can gsum gyi byang chub bsgrub pa'i tshul/ rgyu dang*/ lam dang*/ 'bras bu'i rnam par gzhag pa dang*/ bye brag tu smra ba dang*/ mdo sde pa dang*/ sems tsam rnams bcas pa dang*/ rnam med smra ba dang*/ ngo bo nyid med par smra ba rnams kyi grub mtha'i rnam gzhag dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che gang yin pa dang*/ phar phyin dang gsang sngags kyi spyod tshul dang*/ thun mong dag gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs du ma dang*/ sa dang lam gyi 'bras bu'i rnam dbye la sogs pa legs par rtogs shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen por gyur pa yin no// de ltar gnas lnga rig pa kun shes pa'i mig gis mthong ste chos rje nyid kyi gsung las kyang*/ shes bya kun la 'jigs pa med pa thob// ces pa dang*/ sgra pa nga yin rtog ge pa nga*// zhes pa dang*/

shes bya phal cher 'bad pa chung ngus shes// zhes pa dang*/ skye ba skye ba rnams su yang nas yang*// mkhas pa mkhas pa rnams su sngon sbyangs pas// tshe 'dir lan re zung re thos tsam gyis// gzhung lugs kun shes kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal// bzang po zhes gsungs so// de bas na skyes bu chen po blo gros yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bsod nams kyi chu gter las byung zhing yon tan gyi dbyibs mdzes pa 'di ni/ sku tshe snga ma la legs par spyad pa'i bag chags kyi 'od dang ldan pa 'dir yang brtson pas bslabs pa'i phyi bdar gyis gsal bar byas te/ mkhyen pa'i 'od zer gyi lta ngan mus pa yang sel la/ chos kyi snang bas gsal bar byed cing*/ dad pa'i spyi gtsug tu brten na nyon mongs pa'i rims nad sel ba/ bkur sti'i rgyal mtshan la zhag ste gdul bya'i skye bo don du gnyer bas gsol ba btab na/ mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi dgos 'dod 'byung bar 'gyur ro// legs par spyad pa'i mchod sbyin brgyas bsgrubs nas// chos rje dbang po'i gnas su bde bar byon// blo gros lha mig mdzes pa stong ldan pa// rig pa'i 'gros ldan lta ngan bdud dpung 'joms// sngar sbyangs bsod nams chen po las byung nas// brtson pa'i smon lam lcag gis bskul gyur te// yon tan nor bu chen po bdun ldan pa'i// mi dbang kun dgas bstan pa'i gling bzhi skyong*// dge ba phul byung tshad med bzhi bsgrubs te// dpal 'byor bsam gtan bde la longs spyod cing*// mkhyen brtse'i thugs bzang bsdu dngos bzhi dang ldan// bshes gnyen tshangs dbang 'gro don mdzad pa rgyal// rig pa'i gnas lnga las/ phyi ma gsum po'i gzhung gsan tshul ni/ thog mar rang gi yab dge ba'i bshes gnyen gsang sngags 'dzin pa/ brtson pa phul du byung zhing*/ brtse ba chen po dang ldan pa de las/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs mtsho skyes dang*/

yan lag drug pa/ bzang po yongs gzung*/ rin chen 'bar ba/ bdud rtsi 'od/ dbang chu/ rab gnas/ sbyin sreg cho ga 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa/ dril bu skor gsum/ mchod pa'i lag len dang*/ mi g.yo ba/ sgrol ma/ 'jam dpal/ spyan ras gzigs/ gdugs kar/ rnam rgyal/ 'od zer can/ rnam 'joms la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs thugs dam du mdzad pa rnams dang*/ rtsa ltung*/ bla ma lnga bcu pa/ sdom pa nyi shu pa/ phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs su grags pa brtag pa'i skor dang bcas pa/ sman dpyad kyi gzhung dang man ngag rnams gsan no// yang rang gi khu bo dge ba'i bshes gnyen sde snod kyi mnga' bdag shes rab mi 'phrogs pa dang ldan zhing chos rnams kyi de kho na nyid thugs su chud pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pas byin gyis brlabs shing gzhan don la brtson pa'i go cha chen po can/ rgyal sras gzhon nu'i sa bon la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che mdzad pa/ yi dam lha las dngos su gnang ba thob cing*/ mdo rgyud dang man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdzod du gyur pa/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan la yun ring du bsten cing gsan pa'i rim pa ni/ gsang sngags rnal 'byor chen po la/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi bskur nas/ zhus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa dang*/ bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje gur/ saṃ pu ṭa/ thig le skor gyi rgyud bzhi/ 'grel pa ku mu ta'i bshad pa/ dkyil chog sgrub thabs du ma dang bcas pa/ pad ma can/ nag po dka' 'grel/ bha ba ma/ mu tig phreng ba/ rnal 'byor rin po che'i phreng ba/ dkyil chog sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa/ rā l̥'i rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa/ gur gyi 'grel chung*/ saṃ pu ṭa'i 'grel pa in+d+ra bhū ti ma/ brtag pa gnyis kyi skabs 'grel brgyad/ grub pa sde brgyad/ grub pa'i khongs su gtogs pa phran du ma/ snying po'i skor phra mo nyi shu rtsa lnga yan lag dang bcas pa/

shin tu zab pa'i man ngag gis brgyan pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag dang*/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pas gtso byas pa lam skor dgu phra mo dang bcas pa/ re re'ang man ngag du mas brgyan cing de dag lung sbyor dang bcas pa gsan no// 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur nas/ de'i skor la bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ a bhi dha na/ he ru ka mngon 'byung*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ kun spyod/ rnal 'byor ma/ kha sbyor/ sdom pa 'byung ba/ phag mo mngon 'byung*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ 'grel pa koṅka na dkyil chog sgrub thabs dang bcas pa/ kaṃ pa la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang kun spyod kyi 'grel pa/ gnyis ka'i bshad sbyar/ lū hi pa'i rtsa bshad 'grel pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa'i chos gsum/ koṅka na'i dkyil chog sgrub thabs dang bcas pa/ nag po spyod pa'i rdo rje'i chos drug man ngag dang bcas pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i chos drug nā ro pa'i chos drug brgyud pa mi gcig pa gnyis/ nā ro mkha' spyod/ rtsa dbu ma la sogs pa thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag skor dang bcas pa/ mi trī mkha' spyod/ lhan skyes rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs phra mo'i chos skor dang bcas pa gsan no// gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa dang*/ dkyil chog sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa gsan no// gsang ba 'dus pa rgyud rkyang gi bshad pa dang*/ bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje phreng ba/ lha mo bzhis zhus/ dgongs pa lung ston/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa rnams gsan no// slob dpon 'phags pa'i skor la/ 'grel pa sgron gsal/ mdor byas/ mdor bsre/ rim lnga/ spyod bsdus/ dkyil chog nyi shu pa/ bdag byin gyis brlab pa/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong*/ byang chub sems 'grel/ sgrub thabs kyi rnam gzhag rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs rnams gsan no// sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs skor la/

'jam dpal gyi lung khong rang gis mdzad pa/ zhal gyi chos bcu bdun/ kun tu bzang po'i rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa/ rgyud kyi 'grel pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyan dza yan+ta/ rin chen ljon shing*/ dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel/ mi bskyod rdo rje sgrub thabs bstan pa'i nor rdzas/ 'khor lo'i rkang pa la sogs pa du ma gsan no// sman zhabs kyi skor la/ zhal gyi lung dang mthun pa'i chos bcu bdun pa dang*/ mar me mdzad kyi dkyil chog rnams kyi 'grel pa bcu dgu dngos grub 'byung ba'i gter la sogs pa/ man ngag dang bcas pa gsan no// mtshan yang dag par brjod pa man ngag gi bshad pa/ 'grel pa chen po sngags don rnam gzigs/ lam+bu ṭī ka zla bzang ma/ rnam par rtog ge gsang ldan la sogs pa phran dang bcas pa gsan no// dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor drug rtsis kyi man ngag phra mo dang bcas pa gsan no// do ka'i chos de nyid bcu pa la sogs pa phran du ma dang bcas pa gsan no// de kho na nyid 'jug pa la sogs pa sngags spyi'i bstan bcos mang du gsan no// gsang sngags snga 'gyur la sgyu 'phrul/ gsang rnying*/ snga 'gyur lnga/ rdo rje phur pa/ yang dag sgron ma drug la sogs pa gsan no// rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la/ de nyid bsdus pa rtsa ba'i bshad pa/ 'grel pa de nyid snang ba/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo dpal mchog dang po/ khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal/ mgon po kun snang*/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ dpa' bo grub pa/ dkyil chog rdo rje 'byung ba/ gtsug dgu/ kun rig rab tu gsang ba'i rgyud/ sku gzugs kyi cha dbye ba la sogs pa rnams dang*/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang sems dpa' 'byung ba dang bcas pa la sogs pa phran mang ba zhig gsan no// spyod pa'i rgyud la/ rnam snang mngon byung*/ mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa chen mo le'u dgu pa le'u bdun pa rnams gsan no// bya ba'i rgyud la/ legs par grub pa/ dpung pa bzang po/

gsang ba spyi rgyud/ bsam gtan phyi ma/ dam tshig gsum bkod/ don yod zhags pa/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ gzungs gra lnga/ rnam rgyal/ dri med/ 'od zer can la sogs pa gzungs phra mo dpag tu med pa cho ga dang bcas pa rnams gsan no// bya spyod gnyis kyi dbang rigs gsum mgon po/ mi g.yo ba/ sgrol ma'i rig pa gtad pa rnams zhus so// de dag gi sgrub thabs la/ jo bo rje nas brgyud pa/ mi g.yo ba'i dmigs pa skor gsum/ phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa dang*/ pham thing pa las brgyud pa seng ge sgra'i gdon dgrol la sogs pa/ rdo rje gdan pa'i chos drug dang*/ ba ri ba'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa dang*/ gnyan gyi sgrol ma la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsan no// dam tshig skor la rtsa ltung gi 'grel pa gsum/ chos skyong rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral bran g.yog gi man ngag dang bcas pa/ mgon po gdong bzhi pa/ bya rog ma/ lha mo srog sgrub/ dkar mo nyi zla stong gi phreng ba phur srung rnam gsum/ bdud thod 'phreng can la sogs pa mang zhig gsan te/ brjod par ga la nus/ yon bdag la dzam+bha la ser nag tshogs bdag /rnam thos sras/ nor rgyun ma/ a pa rā dzi ta la sogs pa mang du gsan no// phar phyin gyi phyogs la sangs rgyas phal po che tshar gcig dkon mchog brtsegs pa/ bstan bcos la skyes pa'i rabs/ rin chen phreng ba/ bshes pa'i spring yig bzhi brgya pa/ dbu ma la 'jug spyod 'jug bslab btus/ mdo kun las btus gnyis/ ka ni ka la spring ba/ phung po lnga'i rab byed/ gnas gsum pa/ spel mar bstod pa/ lha las phul du byung ba/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstod pa/ bsngags par 'os pa/ klu sgrub kyi bstod pa'i skor la sogs pa/ bka' gdams lam rim la sogs pa gdams ngag du ma gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad/ kha rag skor gsum/ bod la yod pa'i sgra smra sgo mtshon cha/ bod kyi bde 'jug la sogs pa la mkhas shing dag par byas so// bya rang ka la sogs pa yang gsan/

'phral skad rgya gar skad dang lab tu btub pa dang*/ saṃ skṛ ta yang chos go ba tsam 'gyur yang ci rigs pa mkhyen par bslabs so// //yang dge ba'i bshes las mang du thos shing rigs par smra ba'i mchog tu gyur par grags pa/ skyong dur ba gzhon nu seng ge las/ rtog ge tshad ma'i gzhung*/ rnam par nges pa gzhal bya shes rab sgron ma'i phreng ba dang bcas pa gsan nas mkhas par mdzad do// dbu ma rtsa ba'i shes rab tshig gsal/ rtog ge tho ba stong thun dang bcas pa gsan/ yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po mkhas pa du ma bsten nas blo gros gsal ba'i 'od zer gyis/ lta ba ngan pa'i mun pa bsal zhing don dang ldan pa'i smra ba'i snang bas/ slob ma pad+mo'i tshal rab tu rgyas par byed pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar kun tu grags pa'i skyes bu dam pa slob dpon zhu ston zhes bya ba las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i gsang ste zhus nas byams pa'i chos lnga 'grel ba dang bcas pa/ dbu ma rgyan/ bden gnyis/ spyod phyogs phran la sogs pa gsan par mdzad do// //yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po blo gros kyi bang mdzod thos bsam gyi nor gyis gang zhing*/ tshul khrims kyi brjid pa'i lus la yon tan gyi rgyan gyis spras pa/ snying rje'i mig gis gdul bya'i slong ba po mthong na phrin las kyi phyag gis/ rnam grol gyi 'byor pa ster ba'i sbyin bdag chen po lta bu/ bshes gnyen dam pa spyi bo lhas pa chen po las/ sku rab gshegs nas bslab pa dang las kyi cho ga 'don pa zhus nas chos gsan pa ni/ mngon pa kun las btus/ theg bsdus/ 'grel chung*/ nyi khri'i 'grel pa/ brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa/ mdo sdud pa rnams gsan/ man ngag la bka' gdams lam rim skor bcas/ dbu ma chen mo/ zhi byed/ gcod/ kha rag skor gsum/ rmog cog pa las brgyud de 'ongs pa na ro chos drug rim pa lnga stan thog gcig pa/ rdo rje phag mo/ rnam 'joms gnur lugs rdzogs pa/

yi ge drug pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ dbyangs can ma rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ de la sogs pa man ngag du ma cig gsan no// //kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta bsod snyoms pa chen po tshul khrims dang ldan zhing*/ thugs blo gros rgya mtsho ltar gyur pa shes bya'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing*/ bsgrub pa la brtson pas dub pa med pa phul du phyin pa'i rtogs pa dang ldan zhing*/ yi dam lha du ma'i gnang ba thob pa/ rgyal ba'i bstan la kun mkhyen gnyis pa ltar grags shing*/ ston pa'i bya ba mdzad pa shākya shrī bha dra las/ legs par sbyar ba saṃ skṛ ta'i skad sbyangs shing*/ rtog ge'i bstan bcos thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bu kun las btus pa dang*/ de'i don rgya cher ston pa rig pa'i rgyal po rnam 'grel dang*/ de'i 'grel pa stong phrag phyed dang bzhi pa dang*/ rgyan dang*/ lha dbang blo dang*/ rnam nges kyi 'grel pa chos mchog rig thigs/ rgyud gzhan grub pa/ gtan tshigs thigs pa/ dmigs pa brtag pa/ rab byed phra mo dang bcas pa/ chos mngon pa mdzod gsan/ de nyid kyi drung du sku bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes nas/ 'dul ba mdo dang*/ so sor thar pa sum brgya pa/ dge slong gi kā ri kā dang*/ pha rol du phyin pa bdun brgya ba dang*/ rdo rje gcod pa/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa'i brgyad stong pa'i don bsdus rtsa 'grel/ theg pa chen po nyi shu pa/ sum cu pa/ rnam bshad rigs pa/ kaṃ pa la'i phreng ba'i phreng ba/ rang bzhin gsum pa 'jug pa la sogs pa'i mngon pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i bstan bcos bod la grags pa dang*/ ma grags pa phal cher gsan no// de nyid las dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhus nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang*/ de'i 'grel pa dri ma med pa'i 'od dang*/ dkyil chog sgrub thabs/ mtshan brjod/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad lugs kyi 'grel pa/

dbu mal dga' ba'i 'grel pa/ brtag gnyis la byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ bde mchog phyag na rdo rje'i bstod 'grel/ gsang 'dus kyi dkyil chog la/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa dang*/ shar phyogs pas mdzad pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi man ngag du ma sngon gyi grub thob rnams kyi dbyangs dang*/ sgrol ma dang*/ 'jam dpal la sogs pa phran du ma cig gsan no// //yang de'i slob ma dbang po gsal zhing yid gzhungs pa/ yon tan la 'bad pa cher bslabs nas/ brjod pa gsal pos gzhan la brda sprod pa la mkhas pa saṃ skṛ ta'i skad smra ba'i mchog bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta saṅgha shrī las sgra'i bstan bcos tsan+d+ra pa/ su ban+ta/ ti ngan ta/ sdeb sbyor pṛt+ta ma la/ snyan ngag snang ba'i nyi ma la sogs pa skyes pa'i rabs/ slob dpon seng ge zhabs kyi skyes rabs chen mo dpa' bo'i la mthud nas phar phyin re re la bcu tshan re re ste drug cu tshang ba dang*/ me tog phreng 'dzin/ tshad ma chos mchog chung ba/ gzhan rab byed phra mo 'ga' dang bcas pa gsan cing mkhyen par mdzad do// //yang mdzes pa'i gangs ri la brten nas blo gros kyi rtsal rdzogs shing yon tan gyi ral pas brgyan te/ rigs pa'i mche sder gyis phyir rgol gyi glang po dregs pas myos pa'i klad pa 'gems pa/ smra ba'i skyes bu mchog tu grags pa'i skyes bu shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la zhes bya ba las/ bram ze shang ka ra nan+da la sogs pa'i tshad ma'i skor 'ga' dang*/ rtsod pa'i rigs pa rtsa 'grel dang*// rgyud gzhan grub pa'i rtsa 'grel/ 'grel pa brtag pa'i 'grel/ dz+nyā na shrī'i rab byed/ sel ba brtag pa'i rab byed la sogs pa dang*/ phyir sbyor ba'i dbyangs dang*/ gshin rje gshed dmar po/ mi g.yo ba dkar po la sogs pa gsan pa yin no// bram ze'i rigs paṇ+ḍi ta sug ta shrī zhes bya ba las/ phyi rol pa'i rig byed bzhi sgra nges par sbyar ba dang bcas pa la mkhas par grags nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad nas zhus te/

gsung rab kyi don legs par bslabs pa lta ba grub mtha' dag par shes shing*/ blo gros mi zad pa'i gter chen po/ chos la gnas pa'i skyes bu dam pa kha che paṇ+ḍi ta'i drung du phyin pa'i dus su mjal ba nas bzung ste/ dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon par yun ring du bsten nas chos gsan pa la/ sgra ka lā pa dang*/ ming dang khams sgrub pa'i rab byed gnyis/ tshig sgrub pa/ pra kṛ ya/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas/ snyan ngag nyi ma'i 'od chen po gsum dang*/ gzhon nu 'byung ba la sogs pa chung ngu gsum dang*/ mngon brjod a mar ko ṣā/ zlos gar gyi bstan bcos bha ra ta/ klu rnams rab tu dga' bar byed pa'i zlos gar/ phyi dang nang gi grub mtha'i gnad rnams dang*/ tshad ma'i bstan bcos 'ga'/ rgyud rdo rje sa 'og rdo rje snying po'i rgyan la sogs pa gsan no// paṇ+ḍi ta de dang rdo rje sa 'og la sogs pa'i rgyud rnams dang*/ skyes rabs chen po dang*/ tshad ma'i 'grel pa dang*/ rab byed mang zhig gi 'gyur yang mdzad do// gzhan rgya gar paṇ+ḍi ta dang rnal 'byor pa rnams las byung ba'i man ngag phra mo dpag tu med pa gsan/ bod kyi yon tan shes pa rnams kyis phul ba'i rig pa ngo mtshar can grangs med pa'i mdzod chen por gyur pa yin no// //yan lag brgyad ldan chu bo rnams// yul nas yul du mngon byung nas// rgya mtsho chen po'i gnas su bab// nam mkha'i char gyis rgyas par byed// de bzhin mdo rgyud chu bo rnams// mkhas pa'i yul nas legs byung nas// skyes chen blo gros rgya mtshor bab// man ngag char gyi gang bar byas// gting mtha' rab yangs blo gros rgya mtsho 'khon// rnam mang thos pa'i chab kyis legs bkang nas// yon tan rin chen kun gyi gter gyur pa// chos rje rgya mtsho'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal// de ltar skyes thob kyi shes rab phul du phyin pa dang ldan zhing*/ brtson pa dang 'bad pa chen pos yun ring du bslab sbyong mdzad pas/

mang du thos par gyur nas/ mkhas pa'i byed pa ci lta bu dang ldan zhe na/ grub pa'i mtha' la mkhas pa'i tshul gsum du shes ldan rnams smra ste/ gang zhe na/ smras pa/ bshad pa'i ngag gi zer gyis gzhan blo'i mun pa sel// rtsom pa legs bshad phreng bas mkhas rnams dga' bskyed// rtsod pa rigs pa'i mtshon chas phas kyi rgol ba 'joms// gzhan rigs mkhas pa mthar phyin dgos pa grub pa 'dzin// don brjod na bshad pa ngag gi zer gyis gzhan blo'i mun pa sel ba dang*/ rtsom pa legs bshad kyi phreng bas mkhas pa rnams dga' ba skyed pa dang*/ rtsod pa'i rigs pa'i mtshon chas phas kyi rgol ba'i dpung 'joms pa'o// de dag kyang 'di la mnga' ste/ chos gsung ba na gzhung gang yin na yang*/ tshig dang don du bcas pa mi 'gal zhing 'brel la ma bldabs shing tshang la/ don ci lta ba bzhin du 'khrul ba med par sgra gsal zhing rdzogs la/ rnar snyan cing blo la 'bab pa'i gsung gis brda sprod par byed pa yin te/ 'dis dgung lo bdun lon pa na/ mtsho skyes la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs rnams thugs las gsung zhing*/ lo bcu gcig pa na brtag pa gnyis pa stong thun rnam gzhag dang bcas pa thugs las gsungs te/ de nas sngags kyi rgyud sde mang po gsungs la/ dgung lo bcu dgu la tshad ma rnam nges tshar gsum gsan nas dpe la ma ltos par gsungs pa nas bzung ste/ ding sang gi bar du gzhung lugs du ma rgyun ma chad par 'chad pa nas/ gsung gi 'od zer gyis nyan pa po'i mi shes pa'i mun pa sel zhing*/ blo gros kyi pad mo rgyas par byed la/ chos kyi snang ba rgya chen po bskyed pa'i phyir/ nyi ma'i zer bas kyang mchog tu gyur pa yin no// rtsom pa'i tshul la phan pa dang sdeb sbyor gtsor byed pa gnyis las/ phan pa gtsor mdzad pa yang don dang tshig la skyon med cing*/ 'brel chags pa'i ngag gis mdo rgyud dang mthun par brjod bya gsal bar ston cing*/

mkhas pa rnams kyis skyon gdags par mi nus la/ ngo mtshar du blta ba kho na yin no// sdeb sbyor gtsor mdzad na yang bde bar gshegs pa'i bstod pa dang*/ thugs rje la bskul ba dang*/ legs par bshad pa la sogs pa sdeb legs shing*/ dpe don mi 'gal ba lci yang dang ring thung la sogs pa legs par phyed cing*/ tshig gi rgyan dang ngal bso ba'i gnas kyis mdzes par byas la/ rtsom pa'i phreng ba mchog tu gyur pa mdzad pa rnams ni brjod bde zhing*/ rnar snyan la yid du 'ong ba sha stag yin te/ gser gyi rgyan dang*/ rin po che pad+ma rā ga dang*/ in+d+ra nī la la sogs pas spras pa/ mu tig phreng ba blta na sdug pa bas kyang mchog tu mdzes pa'i bstan bcos rnams ni mthong zhing thos pa na/ mkhas pa rnams yid dga' ba skye zhing blo gsal zhing gzhon nu rnams kyi kha rgyan du gyur la/ shes ldan rnams yid smon gyi gnas su byed pa 'ba' zhig mdzad pa'o// 'di'i rtsod pa'i tshul ni/ 'gran zla med pa'i blo gros dang ldan zhing*/ 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa brnyes pa dang*/ phyin ci ma log pa'i gzhung lugs mkhyen pa'i dbang gis rnam par dag pa'i ngag gis smra ste/ skyon med pa'i dam bca' yang dag par brjod cing*/ bzlog mi nus pa'i thal ba'i 'phen pas phyir rgol gyi spobs pa myur du 'joms pa yin te/ rang gi sde pa la bod kyi sde pa blo gsal mkhas pa chen por rlom zhing smra ba por grags pa du ma yang pham par mdzad cing*/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta 'ga' zhig kyang zil gyis mnan la/ gzhan gyi sde pa 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa phyi rol pa'i mkhas pa chen po drug kyang spobs pa med par byas nas/ lta ba mchog la btsud pa yin la/ des na blo gros kyi nam mkha' rigs pa'i chu 'dzin bsdus te/ spobs pa'i rlung shugs kyis thal 'gyur gyi rdo ba 'phangs nas/ phas rgol gting tshugs par smra ba'i log rtog gi ri bo bsnyil bar byed pa/

gnam lcags pas kyang nus pa khyad par 'phags pa yin la/ de dag gi tshul yang kho bos bstod pa'i skabs la legs par smras pa yin no// rig pa'i gnas gzhan rnams ni mthar thug par rtogs nas/ rang gi legs par bsgrub pa dang*/ gzhan la phan par byas pa la sogs pa dgos pa ci lta ba bzhin du bsgrubs par mdzad pa yin no// skad gnyis smra ba la mkhas pas 'gyur mdzad pa rnams kyang paṇ+ḍi ta la ltos pa'am ma ltos kyang rung ste/ rgya gar gyi sgra dang mthun cing*/ bod skad la bde la/ don ci lta ba bzhin du 'byung ba shin tu legs par mdzad pa yin no// de ltar skyes bu dam pa 'di ni/ rigs dang gzugs phun sum tshogs shing blo gros phul du byung ba dang ldan la/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas shing nyes pa phra mos kyang ma gos la/ thos pa rgya chen po mdzad cing rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa/ brtson pas lam bsgrub cing yon tan gyi tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ rtogs pa'i mchog dang ldan zhing gzhan don la rab tu brtson pa'i bdag nyid chen po/ rgyal ba'i phrin las bsgrub cing bstan pa'i sgron mar gyur pa/ lus can gyi mgon skyabs mdzad pa/ mkhas pa'i tshogs kyi bsngags pa byed cing*/ ya rabs chen po rnams kyis bkur ba'i gnas su gyur pa/ 'jig rten na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral zhing mchog tu gyur pa'i skyes bur gyur par grags pa/ snyan pa'i ba dan yon tan gyi rlung gis bskyod nas/ gdul bya'i dbang po tshim par mdzad pa'i/ dpal sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta zhes sgrogs pa ni/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs la mnga' ba yin no// bdag nyid chen po'i yon tan mdor bsdu na// rigs gzugs 'byor ba phun tshogs lha dbang bzhin// shes bya'i gnas la kun mkhyen lta bu lags// mchod par 'os la gtong phod ldan dang mtshungs// do zlas dben pa 'khor los sgyur ba ltar// 'jig rten gsal byed 'od zer brgya pa bzhin// nyon mongs gdung sel bsil zer byed dang mtshungs// dgos 'dod kun 'byung dpag bsam ljon pa lags// rtag tu phan sems pha ma lta bu ste// sdug bsngal nad sel sman pa'i rgyal po mchog

/yon tan kun ldan mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs// 'gro ba'i bla ma khyod zhabs rtag tu mchod// //'di'i yon tan gyi cha gzhan bsgrub pa las byung ba/ zab mo'i chos gsar du rtogs pa dang*/ khyad par can gyi phrin las dang*/ yi dam lhas byin gyis brlab pa la sogs pa yon tan rin po che mchog tu ngo mtshar ba dpag tu med pa cig yod mod kyang*/ mtha' dag pa bdag gis brjod par mi spobs la/ rags rim rtogs pa rnams kyang bkas ma gnang ba'i phyir ma smos pa yin no// 'on kyang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs la mnga' zhes smras pa de nyid kyi mdor bsdus nas bstan pa yin la/ rgyas par brjod pa la mtha' yas shing yon tan gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pas brgyan pa'i bdag nyid chen po 'di la/ sems dwang bas rab tu dwang bas gsol ba 'debs pa'i brtson 'grus kyi go cha ba go bar bya'o// thugs rjes 'dzin cing byin rlabs myur du 'jug par 'gyur ro// //blo gros pad 'dab rab rgyas rgya che mkhyen pa'i kha dog rab gsal zhing*// tshul khrims ze'u 'bru rab tu mdzes par snang ba'i rtogs pa'i lte ba can// yon tan sbrang rtsi mchog la mchog tu dga' ba'i blo gsal sbrang bu'i tshogs// legs spyad dar dir sgra sgrogs 'dus pa'i tshogs bcas chos rje skye dgu'i rgyal// mi mchog khyod kyi yon tan phung po dpag med nam mkha'i mtha'// bdag blo'i bung bas legs par blta phyir kun du 'bad na yang*// shes rab 'phur rtsal zhan pas cha shas tsam yang rtogs dka' mod// de lta na yang dga' ba'i yid kyis dbyangs snyan sgrogs par byed// bla ma'i rnam thar cung zad brjod pa 'di// blo ldan rgyal ba'i dpal la don gnyer ba'i// grogs mchog gsum gyis bskul nas legs par bris// dge bas thams cad bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /bla ma'i chos tshul bla med legs thob nas// rnam thar phul byung rnam mang bsgrub byas te// srid pa'i skye bo srid las legs bsgral nas// bde ba'i gnas su byang chub bde thob shog

/mkhas pas byed pa mthong dang thos pa dang*// dran dang dad cing yid la gang byed pa// de yi rgyud la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// ye shes gzigs pa myur du 'jug par 'gyur// yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po brda sprod pa po rnams kyi nang na gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa sde snod 'dzin pa sa skya pa'i rnam thar/ gung thang gi btsun pa zhang rgyal ba dpal gyis u rgyan gyi dgon par bris so// sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam thar i thi// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
